needs_human.note: While the name filter is active, the new effect at FolderBrowser.tsx:618-620 runs `keepOnly(visibleFileIds)` on every change of `files`, including list reloads that briefly empty `files`. Each such reload clears the whole selection and the Shift anchor, even though the filter has hidden nothing.

Whether the selection should survive a list reload (websocket structure or file_updated event, refresh after a bulk action) while the name filter is active is not specified. The base keeps it; the change now clears it.; FolderBrowser.tsx:792 still passes the toolbar `fileIds={files.map(...)}` from the unfiltered list to addon bulk-action slots. This is pre-existing and not touched.; handlePlayAll and hasPlayableFiles still read the unfiltered `files`, so Play all can start on a row the filter hides. This is pre-existing.; Renaming a selected file (inline) so that it no longer matches the filter now drops it from the selection silently. This is consistent with the stated UNSPEC, but no test covers it.

While the name filter is active, any refresh clears the whole selection and the Shift anchor. That covers an upload completing, a move completing in another pane, a paste, a websocket structure event, and a sort, type or folder key change.; After a partial or stopped batch delete or purge with the filter active, the remaining ids meant for retry are wiped and the SelectionBar unmounts along with its outcome message and retry state.
